name: Morbihan Terradata public departmental data center, Vannes
notes: Official Morbihan Énergies project page says a public departmental data center will be built on its Vannes administrative site, with ISO 27001 and HDS target security/certification levels.

name: Lorient Agglomération low-carbon public data center
notes: Official Lorient Agglomération announcement says the low-carbon containerized data center was inaugurated to host public-service data, with local backup data center replication; investment reported at EUR1.6m.

name: Saint-Avold / Émile-Huchet power station data center proposal
notes: DCD reports a 300MW data center could be developed at the Saint-Avold industrial site in Moselle; work was described as planned to start in 2028 while partner discussions continued.

name: Databalt Nevers data center
notes: Databalt states its headquarters and main site are in Nevers; business registry and cluster listings describe creation/management of datacenters, hosting, backup, GPU compute, and PRA/PCA services at Avenue du Colonel Rossel, 58000 Nevers.

name: DATA4 Escaudain AI data center campus
notes: DATA4 announced a EUR5bn campus on the former Parc des Soufflantes industrial site in Escaudain; the 33-hectare campus is expected ultimately to deliver 700MW.

name: SoftBank AI data center, Dunkirk (Loon-Plage)
developer: SoftBank Group / SB Energy / strategic partners
notes: SoftBank announced a 5GW France AI infrastructure program; first phase totals 3.1GW in Hauts-de-France by 2031 and names Dunkirk (Loon-Plage), Bosquel, and Bouchain as data center locations. Individual site MW not disclosed.

name: SoftBank AI data center, Bouchain
developer: SoftBank Group / EDF / SB Energy / strategic partners
notes: SoftBank named Bouchain as one of three first-phase Hauts-de-France AI data center locations; the release says EDF is involved for the Bouchain site. Individual site MW not disclosed.

name: Microsoft Quaëdypre data center proposal
notes: DCD, citing La Voix du Nord, reports Microsoft was looking at a 20.5-hectare data center site in Quaëdypre, Hauts de Flandre, in the Nord department; Microsoft had not confirmed specifications or timeline.

name: OVHcloud Roubaix data center region / campus
notes: OVHcloud official materials list Roubaix among its French 1-AZ regions and its status page lists multiple Roubaix zones (RBX-1 through RBX-10, excluding RBX-9 in the displayed list).

name: OVHcloud Gravelines data center region / campus
notes: OVHcloud official materials list Gravelines among its French 1-AZ regions and its status page lists Gravelines zones; local reporting says OVH began the Gravelines site in a former Rexam factory and later expanded capacity.

name: Rantigny digital campus / data center
notes: Official Communauté de communes du Liancourtois - Vallée Dorée page describes the Rantigny data center project as cloud/AI infrastructure with a 300MW grid connection and expected local employment impacts.

name: AZNETWORK Alençon data center
notes: AZNETWORK says it owns a 100% French data center for hosting infrastructure and lists its address at 40 Rue Ampère, 61000 Alençon; Orne departmental material describes AZNetwork as having created a regional data center for up to 1,000 servers.

name: Telehouse Paris Voltaire
notes: Telehouse official Paris page identifies Voltaire as a core Paris internet hub; ISO certificate lists Telehouse Voltaire at 137 Boulevard Voltaire, Paris 75011 for co-location facilities.

name: Telehouse Paris Jeûneurs
notes: Telehouse says Paris Jeûneurs opened in 1996; ISO certificate lists the site at 38 Rue des Jeuneurs, Paris 75002 for co-location facilities.

name: Nebius / Azur Datacenter Béthune AI data center
notes: Nord France Invest says Nebius plans to deploy 240MW of AI compute infrastructure at the former Bridgestone site in Béthune with Azur Datacenter; DCD reports phased delivery and about 26,000 sqm.

name: Microsoft Vieille-Église data center proposal
notes: DCD, citing La Voix du Nord, reports Microsoft was looking to develop a data center outside Calais in Vieille-Église, Pas-de-Calais; company confirmation, specifications, and timeline were not available.

name: Microsoft Zouafques data center proposal
notes: DCD, citing La Voix du Nord, reports Microsoft was looking to develop another Pas-de-Calais facility in Zouafques; company confirmation, specifications, and timeline were not available.

name: o2switch Clermont-Ferrand data centers
notes: o2switch states that it owns and manages its own data centers in Clermont-Ferrand, France, with 24/7 operations and services hosted in France without an intermediary.

name: Pau public proximity data center
developer: Communauté d’Agglomération Pau Béarn Pyrénées / Fibre Paloise / Axione
notes: Pau official page says the first public proximity data center in Pyrénées-Atlantiques is under construction near the municipal technical center and due in October 2027; DCMag reports 120kW IT environment, 450 sqm main building, and Tier 3-aligned resilience.
